instruction.text: Matthew asked his year what their favourite fruits are. 30 voted for strawberries, 24 voted for bananas, 6 voted for apples and 12 voted for mango. Finish filling in this bar chart to show this.
Matthew needs help to change the scale of his bar chart. This time, instead of going up in 3s, his scale goes up in 6s. Finish filling in the bar chart to show this.
instruction.sound: Matthew needs help to change the scale of his bar chart. This time, instead of going up in threes, his scale goes up in sixes. Finish filling in the bar chart to show this.

instruction.text: Answer the following questions using the bar chart.

atoms.a: What is the difference between the number of votes for the most popular and the least popular fruit?
What is the difference between the number of votes for bananas and mangoes?
If each child only voted once, what is the total number of children in Matthew’s year?
